Implementation details: Use Locale("en","US") etc. Ensure variant locales exist: Locale("en","US","WIN") is variant, but need to ensure it's in available locales? Not necessarily; but we can construct variant manually. languagesByCountry should filter out variant locales; we can add a custom locale via constructing but not in available locales list; however the method iterates over availableLocaleList which comes from Locale.getAvailableLocales, which may not include custom locales. So we can test that languagesByCountry("US") list does not contain variant locales (i.e., Locale("en","US","POSIX")). We'll check that none of returned locales have variant length>0.

Similarly countriesByLanguage for language "en" should exclude variants.

Test immutability: attempt to modify list returned and expect UnsupportedOperationException.

Test availableLocaleSet contains same elements as list.
